elements.texte:
[cheerful] At the end of the query, we add order by and the column to sort by.

The rows are sorted by stock, from smallest to largest: that’s the default direction, ascending.

Order by doesn’t delete any row: it only changes their order.

But the suspicious stock of 500 ends up at the very bottom.
